title: SIA’s S$2 billion new cabin seats draw both praise and flak
text:
SIA's S$2 billion new cabin seats draw both praise and flak - The Business Times Search
 Subscribe SIA’s S$2 billion new cabin seats draw both praise and flak
 The seats in first class were well-received while the design for business class was criticised

 Published Mon, Nov 9, 2026 · 09:35 PM 阅读简体中文版 (beta) 
 SIA unveiled its cabin seat products with much fanfare. PHOTO: ST 
 [SINGAPORE] Singapore Airlines (SIA)’ recently unveiled cabin seats for long-haul routes got both bouquets and brickbats amid high anticipation for the products.
 The carrier’s new first class seats will be introduced on the retrofitted Airbus 350 fleet for the very first time, and also on the brand-new Boeing 777-9 planes. The seats impressed with their warm and luxurious design as well as functionality.
 Customers travelling together can request to open the privacy divider between the centre seats in first class cabin, creating a shared space for dining and relaxing. IMAGE: SINGAPORE AIRLINES Ben Schlappig, travel blogger behind points and premium travel site One Mile at a Time, described the first class seats as “elegant, and looks on-brand for Singapore Airlines”.
